data.body: Local operator changes outside any pull request: .env gained POSTGRES_HOST_PORT=15432, compose.massgov.yaml dropped its duplicate Postgres port override with the effective mapping unchanged at 15432, config/local/checks.yaml gained the archive-massgov-pfml entry, and .venv was reinstalled with the all and dev extras after uv run rebuilt it with base packages only. Backups of .env, compose.massgov.yaml, and checks.yaml are under the session TMPDIR.
